description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the LocationStats class, testing statistics aggregation for user and project location data within the Goteo platform.

classes.name: LocationStatsTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case class for testing LocationStats functionality with user and project location data.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests that LocationStats can be instantiated correctly with UserLocation and User objects.

methods.name: testUserStats
methods.description: Tests statistics methods of LocationStats related to users, including counts for located, unlocated, unlocable, and filtered data, and grouping.

methods.name: testProjectStats
methods.description: Tests statistics methods of LocationStats related to projects, including counts for located, unlocated, unlocable, and filtered data, and grouping.
